normalized_rule: Phaladeepika says a bhava is strong and beneficent when a Trikona, the 2nd, 4th, 7th, or 10th from it is occupied by auspicious planets or the bhava lord and is free from malefic occupancy/aspect.
synthesis_notes: This is a Mantreswara/Phaladeepika proposition, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The source Trikona support is included in the user-facing normalized condition.
transmission_notes: The 1937 Sastri English translation is used as a reference-only source layer.
